inventory_boundary.source_ref: raw/paper.pdf (36 pages; Letter and complete embedded Supplementary Material)
inventory_boundary.reason: The complete Letter, all nine supplementary figures, and both supplementary tables were audited through PDF page 36.

_howto: One item is one independently adjudicable theoretical numerical panel, series, or table; split mixed panels when components can fail independently.
Experimental measurements, source-parameter tables, schematics, and literature summaries remain inventoried but do not enter the theoretical denominator.
Coverage requires independent scientific reproduction; digitized curves, author arrays/code, copied panels, and original-image pixels never count.
